SSRF allowlist permits a loopback mock server while private-network protection remains enabled

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
use Crawlberg\CrawlConfig;
$engine_config = CrawlConfig::from_json(json_encode(["respectRobotsTxt" => false, "ssrf" => ["allowlist" => [["type" => "cidr", "value" => "127.0.0.0/8"]], "denyPrivate" => true, "maxRedirects" => 5], "ssrfDenyPrivateExplicit" => true]));
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine($engine_config);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::scrape($engine, $url);
var_dump($result->statusCode);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->title);
```
